comparison_status.PX_PO_vs_PX_EBSS: matched intervention (only the balance term differs)
comparison_status.PX_vs_RS: descriptive (initial content and number of generated tokens differ)

smoke.note: batched-KV BF16 vs batch-1 no-cache BF16 replay differ by kernel-shape rounding; the pilot used the same tolerance

regions.historical_slicing: random-start sequences are sliced identically: continuation = [64:512] (448 generated tokens at the same absolute positions; the random first token and generated tokens 1..63 are excluded), full = [0:512]

repetition.loop_onset: first continuation offset whose next 16 tokens copy an earlier 16-gram of the sequence (prefix included)
repetition.coverage: fraction of continuation positions inside an 8-gram occurring >= 2x in the sequence

routing.primary: CANONICAL-B1 replay of every 512-token sequence; generation-time routing reported separately
routing.exposure_decomposition: per-region counts from the same B1 replay, normalised to relative load count/(tokens*k/E)

primary.BEATS_C4: PX_EBSS mean reconstruction < each of C4R_s0, s1, s2
primary.PARTIAL: not BEATS_C4, and PX_PO < RS_PO or PX_EBSS < RS_EBSS (strict)
primary.NO_GAIN: neither prefix method below its random-start counterpart
primary.reported: relative change and a 'material' flag (<= -0.5 %, the margin of the fidelity study) per method; gap recovery G_m; PPL separately
